visual_brief.subject: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform
verified_context: OpenShell runs agent workloads inside isolated sandboxes and evaluates outbound activity through a supervisor outside the workload.
Real credentials stay outside the sandbox and are substituted only for requests authorized by the external policy.
NVIDIA Sentry is an optional monitoring and enforcement reference design on BlueField-4 DPUs outside the agent host.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A workload and its independent enforcement authority occupy separate physical spaces.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: An ivory working sphere sits inside a thick charcoal cutaway chamber; a separate terracotta sentinel rises behind it, with both forms held in a compact central group.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant graphite chamber and separate observer on a distant plinth. Strong wide illustration, but the lateral separation loses the observer in the tall homepage crop.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant curved stone enclosure with a terracotta external monolith. Clear depth and materiality, but the observer again sits too far right for the featured homepage placement.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. A compact central charcoal chamber and separate terracotta sentinel preserve the boundary relationship in article, mobile, thumbnail, and tall homepage crops. Tactile graphite surfaces and warm paper match the golden references without copying their objects. The sentinel is an editorial metaphor, not a product schematic.
candidate_notes.D: Constitution-compliant stone escarpment cutaway with elevated sentinel. The expansive wall is persuasive in the wide view, but the two important forms are too far apart in the tall homepage crop.

crop_review.article_desktop: Chromium at 1440px viewport: 1100 × 591px cover box; both focal forms survive.
crop_review.article_mobile: Chromium at 390px viewport: 359 × 193px cover box; both focal forms survive without page overflow.
crop_review.homepage_desktop: 589 × 821px center cover crop retains the working sphere, chamber, and independent sentinel; the outer left wall is cropped.
crop_review.homepage_mobile: 357 × 260px center cover crop retains both focal forms.
crop_review.reference_layout: 1200 × 430px cover study partially clips the sentinel disc at the top while retaining the chamber, sphere, and separate sentinel structure.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 × 164px listing crop retains a readable chamber/sentinel silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Two distinct production references were rendered above all candidates on a Chromium contact sheet. Compared palette, density, abstraction, line weight, graphite and paper texture, physical depth, negative space, focal hierarchy, and thumbnail silhouette.
